notes.title: First Update Post Release - Goodbye Job, Goodbye John
notes.notes:
No, I still have a job, and I actually have a few friends named John but, let me explain...

[b]PATCH NOTES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Saying "job" or "john" will register as JUMP
[*] Time will not return to what it was when you originally hit a checkpoint when "returning to checkpoint" from the pause menu
[*] Time saves when you quit the game or return to main menu
[*] New Troll Mask
[*] Win screen will tell you how many bananas you got and the total on the map
[*] You can take off masks and hats entirely
[/list]

It has been fun watching people play my game, and the feedback I've received has been great to help me squash further bugs. I'm just one guy making a game in the attic of my garage, so it's nice to have some help now that the game is out there.

Please continue to spread the word of the game! Thanks for everything.
